The figure presents a schematic diagram illustrating an interaction framework between multiple patient actors and a central Health AI system. The global layout is horizontal and modular, organized into three main vertical columns: on the left, a series of vignettes; in the middle, corresponding patient actors; and on the right, a large rectangular block representing the Health AI system. The structure is sequential and parallel, with each row representing an independent interaction path from a vignette to a patient actor and then to the Health AI.

In terms of visual modules and attributes, all components are represented as simple rectangular boxes with black borders and black text inside. The leftmost column contains N vignettes labeled sequentially as 'Vignette 1', 'Vignette 2', ..., up to 'Vignette N'. These are arranged vertically, with dashed vertical lines between 'Vignette 2' and 'Vignette N' indicating continuation or repetition of the pattern. The middle column contains corresponding patient actors labeled 'Patient Actor 1', 'Patient Actor 2', ..., 'Patient Actor N', aligned directly to the right of their respective vignettes. The rightmost column features a single, tall rectangular box labeled 'Health AI', spanning the height of all patient actors, emphasizing its role as a centralized system.

Connections and arrows depict the flow of interaction. Each vignette has a solid arrow pointing rightward to its corresponding patient actor, indicating that the vignette serves as input or context for the patient actor. From each patient actor, two bidirectional arrows connect to the Health AI: one arrow points from the patient actor to the Health AI, and another points back from the Health AI to the patient actor. This bidirectional connection suggests a two-way communication or feedback loop between each patient actor and the Health AI. All arrows are solid black lines with standard arrowheads, and there are no color distinctions or additional styling applied to any elements. The diagram does not include any mathematical equations or LaTeX expressions, relying solely on textual labels and directional arrows to convey the interaction logic. The overall design is minimalistic and functional, focusing on clarity of the interaction model.
